title: Database privileges granted without a scope limit in sql — review required
description: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES hands an account every right on the target, including DROP and GRANT OPTION when those are implied. A service that only reads one schema then holds the power to destroy it or to grant itself access elsewhere. The rule flags the statement; whether the account is application-facing is a review decision.
remediation: Grant only the statements the account uses, scoped to the schemas it owns, and revoke GRANT OPTION.
limitation: Lexical: matches GRANT ALL in migration or setup SQL; runtime grants issued by an ORM are out of scope.

tests.line: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON app.* TO app_user;
# audit: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON app.* TO app_user; present
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON app.orders TO app_user;
# verified: GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON app.orders TO app_user;
